titre: EvoGuard: An Extensible Agentic RL-based Framework for Practical and Evolving AI-Generated Image Detection
resume: arXiv:2603.17343v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The rapid proliferation of AI-Generated Images (AIGIs) poses severe misinformation risks, making AIGI detection critical yet challenging. Traditional detection paradigms mainly rely on low-level features, whereas recent research increasingly focuses on leveraging the general understanding ability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve better generalization, yet it still suffers from limited extensibility and expensive data annotations.
